summary: Began implementing frontend rendering of the backend 'display' tool's gizmoDisplay spec using @json-render/core and @json-render/svelte 0.20.0 in apps/app. Read Svelte best-practices and code-writer skills, inspected existing ToolCallCard/ToolResult components, package.json, tests directory, and the installed json-render README plus its dist layout (CatalogRenderer, ElementRenderer, etc.). A grep for `gizmoDisplay` and `**/*display*` under packages found no matches, indicating the protocol/display.ts contract from the backend agent is not yet present.
decisions: Target app scope: frontend apps/app files and tests only; backend/protocol/docs owned by another agent (no edits outside app)

Rendering contract expected from backend tool.result: { gizmoDisplay: { version: 1, title?: string, spec } } with spec = { root: string, elements: Record<string, { type, props, children?: string[] }> } and static-only types Heading/Text/Card/Stack/List/Table/Metric/Divider (no HTML, actions, or dynamic expressions)

Display output must render inline in chat within the existing tool result block (ToolCallCard/ToolResult path), not behind an expandable details dump; preserve fallback error rendering for malformed results
Use real @json-render APIs (defineCatalog, Renderer, CatalogRenderer) from installed package rather than assumptions, with theme consistent with existing app UI
Avoid files >=300 lines and avoid committing; run app check/tests and report exact integration/contract
errors: Bash tool invocation of the impeccable context script for apps/app/src/lib/features/conversation/ToolCallCard.svelte returned 'This operation was aborted'
Grep for `gizmoDisplay`/`tool.result` patterns under packages (display contract) yielded no matches, so the backend's shared packages/protocol/src/display.ts is not yet available to inspect
